title: Addition of Unary Polynomial-Time Functions
statement: If $\ell_1$ and $\ell_2$ are functions on finite binary strings whose unary representations, consisting of that many $1$ bits, are computable in polynomial time, then the function $y\mapsto \ell_1(y)+\ell_2(y)$ has a polynomial-time computable unary representation as well.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell_1$ has a polynomial-time computable unary representation
$\ell_2$ has a polynomial-time computable unary representation
